decision_ar: لا مانع ملموس من حفظ الحزمة على فرع الأدلة. نتيجة الحارس الأصلي تثبت هوية النشر المحددة في ثلاث دورات تحقق ناجحة وإغلاق حجز هذه المهمة، ضمن حدود السجلات المجمعة المبينة أدناه.
scope: Bounded local read-only review of saved artifacts and original verifier source; no new tests, host/browser actions, Git changes, or archive modification. Only this review file was written.

prepare_publish.ui_evidence_kind: Task-recorded observation of Deployment finished, new latest published version, and Republish enabled; not a raw Cloud Build transcript.

original_verification.request_label_derivation: 383 ordinary paths with canonical and cache-busted requests, plus build-meta.json under two Accept values and both cache modes: 383*2+4=770.

lease_closure.interpretation: Original verify returned success after its whole-lease equality fence and removal; a subsequent original status independently reports inactive.

first_attempt.cause_observed: git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no returned 128; stderr says index.lock write failed: Out of diskspace.
first_attempt.evidence: Traceback stops at runner preflight Git status, before phase=verifying and before the original verify subprocess call; no first-attempt verify stdout/stderr exists.
first_attempt.recovery_record: Subsequent original Git status returned 0; tracked clean; no foreign files deleted or runner changed.
first_attempt.interpretation: This is a failed wrapper preflight, not a failed production identity verification or a failed first verification probe.

secrets_and_private_data.structured_content_review: Payloads contain release identities, source/artifact manifests, hashes, public route labels, version/cache metadata, task coordination fields and orchestration logs. No raw business records, environment dump, access tokens or secret values observed.
secrets_and_private_data.limit: This is a bounded static inspection of this archive, not a claim that arbitrary unknown secret formats can be exhaustively excluded.

evidence_limits: The original verifier emits an aggregate checks=3 result, first-cycle frontend request labels/cache/service-worker observations, and distinct boot timestamps. It does not retain the three raw health bodies or all per-request response bodies/headers/timestamps.

770 is the first-cycle ordered request-label list. The unmodified verifier source repeats the full frontend check in each of three successful cycles; the archive does not contain three independent raw HTTP transcripts.

The verified=true result and unchanged original guard source imply the required health identity/source/control/hash/Frontend flags passed; those individual raw health boolean payloads are not separately retained.
Boot times are deduplicated in output. One retained distinct timestamp with checks=3 records a common boot identity, not three separate raw boot records.
The Cloud platform revision and completion signals come from recorded UI observations. The bundle contains no raw Cloud Build transcript.
Lease inactivity is evidenced at 15:34:11.304640 UTC. This review performs no later host status read.
Deployment identity verification does not establish financial-source completeness, business-data recovery, or performance improvement.
